summary: mnemonic-utils postinstall exfiltrates installer credentials and wallet material to webhook.site
details: On npm install, postinstall.js reads installer-owned secret files (.env*,.npmrc,.aws/credentials,.ssh private keys such as id_rsa, Solana id.json, Ethereum keystore) and walks the user's home dotfolders collecting any file whose name matches wallet/key/secret/seed/mnemonic/keystore/private (plus.json/.pem). The collected contents are bundled with host identifiers (os.hostname(), os.userInfo().username, timestamp) and POSTed over HTTPS to a hardcoded webhook.site endpoint. The package is advertised as a mnemonic utility, but its only install-time behavior is bulk credential and wallet-material theft tied to a specific installer host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
